risks.description: Presumed fraud risk that revenue is recorded for sales that did not occur, to meet growth expectations (revenue up 15.4% on the prior year).
Risk that sales invoiced before 30 June 2026 are recognised although control of the goods passes to customers after year end; June revenue is 12.5% of the annual total.
Risk that bank balances recorded in the general ledger do not exist or are overstated at 30 June 2026.

SALES CONTRACT
Contract No. CON-001

Date: 20 May 2026

Parties
Seller:   Numbat Electronic Components Pty Ltd (ABN 68 900 042 015)
          Unit 7, 42 Example Parade, Silverwater NSW 2128
Customer: Bilby Robotics Pty Ltd (ABN 11 901 043 383)
          15 Sample Road, Wetherill Park NSW 2164

1. Goods
1.1 The Seller agrees to sell and the Customer agrees to buy the goods described in
the Schedule (Goods) on the terms of this Contract.

Schedule
Item  Description                             Quantity  Unit price (AUD)  Amount (AUD)
1     Servo drive controller module SDC-400        200            560.00    112,000.00
2     Encoder interface board EIB-12               300            100.00     30,000.00
      Total Contract Price (excluding GST)                                  142,000.00

2. Price
2.1 The Total Contract Price is AUD 142,000.00, excluding GST. The price is fixed and
is not subject to any discount, rebate or price adjustment. GST is payable in addition.

3. Delivery Date
3.1 The Seller must deliver the Goods to the Customer's premises at 15 Sample Road,
Wetherill Park NSW 2164 (Delivery Address) on 29 June 2026, or on another date agreed
in writing.
4. Delivery
4.1 The Seller will deliver the Goods at its cost to the Delivery Address. Each
delivery must be accompanied by a delivery note that identifies this Contract.
4.2 The Customer's authorised representative will inspect the Goods on arrival and,
if they conform to this Contract, sign the delivery note.

5. Title and Risk
5.1 Title to and risk in the Goods pass to the Customer when the Customer's authorised
representative signs the delivery note at the Delivery Address. Until then the Goods
remain the property and at the risk of the Seller, and the Seller has no right to
payment for them.

6. Invoicing and Payment
6.1 The Seller may invoice the Goods on or after the date of dispatch.
6.2 The Customer must pay each tax invoice within 30 days after the date of the signed
delivery note, by electronic funds transfer to the Seller's nominated bank account.
7. Warranty
7.1 The Seller warrants that the Goods will be free from defects in materials and
workmanship for 12 months after delivery. The Seller will repair or replace defective
Goods at its cost. This clause does not limit any rights the Customer has under the
Australian Consumer Law.

8. Termination
8.1 Either party may terminate this Contract by written notice if the other party
commits a material breach and does not remedy it within 14 days after receiving notice
of the breach.

9. General
9.1 This Contract is the entire agreement between the parties about its subject
matter. It may be varied only in writing signed by both parties.
9.2 This Contract is governed by the laws of New South Wales.

Signed for Numbat Electronic Components Pty Ltd
Jordan Avery, Director                    Date: 20 May 2026

Signed for Bilby Robotics Pty Ltd
Mei Tran, Director                        Date: 20 May 2026

SUPPLY AGREEMENT
Contract No. CON-003

Date: 16 June 2025

Parties
Supplier: Numbat Electronic Components Pty Ltd (ABN 68 900 042 015)
          Unit 7, 42 Example Parade, Silverwater NSW 2128
Customer: Galah Retail Electronics Pty Ltd (ABN 20 903 046 122)
          120 Placeholder Avenue, Moorebank NSW 2170

Background
The Customer operates electronics retail stores and wishes to buy components and
accessories from the Supplier for resale.

1. Term
1.1 This Agreement starts on 1 July 2025 and ends on 30 June 2027 unless terminated
earlier under clause 8.
1.2 A Contract Year is each 12-month period starting on 1 July.

2. Orders
2.1 The Customer may place purchase orders for products listed in the Supplier's
current price list (Products). This Agreement does not oblige the Customer to buy any
minimum quantity and does not state a total contract value.
2.2 Each accepted purchase order forms a separate contract on the terms of this
Agreement.
3. Price and Payment
3.1 Prices are those in the Supplier's price list current on the date of the purchase
order, excluding GST.
3.2 The Supplier will issue a tax invoice on dispatch of each delivery. The Customer
must pay each tax invoice within 30 days after the invoice date.

4. Delivery, Title and Risk
4.1 The Supplier will deliver Products to the Customer's distribution centre at
120 Placeholder Avenue, Moorebank NSW 2170.
4.2 Title to and risk in Products pass to the Customer when the Customer's receiving
officer signs the delivery docket at the distribution centre.
5. Right of Return
5.1 The Customer may return any Products that are unsold, undamaged and in their
original packaging within 30 days after delivery. The Supplier will issue a credit
note for the full invoiced price of returned Products within 10 business days after
receiving them.

6. Volume Rebate
6.1 If the Customer's total purchases under this Agreement in a Contract Year,
excluding GST and net of returns, exceed AUD 600,000, the Supplier will pay the
Customer a rebate equal to 3% of those total purchases.
6.2 The rebate is paid by credit note within 30 days after the end of the Contract Year.

7. Warranty
7.1 The Supplier warrants that Products will be free from defects in materials and
workmanship for 12 months after delivery. This clause does not limit any rights the
Customer has under the Australian Consumer Law.
8. Termination
8.1 Either party may terminate this Agreement by giving 90 days' written notice to the
other party.
8.2 Either party may terminate this Agreement immediately by written notice if the
other party commits a material breach and does not remedy it within 14 days after
receiving notice of the breach.

9. General
9.1 This Agreement is the entire agreement between the parties about its subject
matter. It may be varied only in writing signed by both parties.
9.2 This Agreement is governed by the laws of New South Wales.

Signed for Numbat Electronic Components Pty Ltd
Jordan Avery, Director                    Date: 16 June 2025

Signed for Galah Retail Electronics Pty Ltd
Harriet Cole, Director                    Date: 16 June 2025
